original: 去年、妻を亡くしたんだ。

en.text: I lost my wife last year.

original: 彼女は良妻賢母だよ。

en.text: She's a wonderful wife and mother.

original: 妻はそんなに文句言わないと願っています。

en.text: I wish that my wife wouldn't complain so much.

original: 彼は妻に腹を立てていた。

en.text: He was angry with his wife.

original: 妻の家族と相手の言語で話したいです。

en.text: I want to talk with my wife's family in their language.

original: 妻と話すために、新しい言葉を学ぶ必要があった。

en.text: I had to learn a new language to talk with my wife.

original: 妻は養子を迎えたいと思っていた。

en.text: My wife wanted to adopt a child.

original: トムは妻の居場所が分からないことを認めた。

en.text: Tom admitted he had no idea where his wife was.
Tom admitted that he had no idea where his wife was.

original: 妻と時々中華を食べに行きます。

en.text: My wife and I sometimes go to eat Chinese.

original: 妻はすぐに帰って来ます。

en.text: My wife will return home soon.
